Information availability: status summaries and prior research access are mentioned, but the richness/integration of datasets and tools is not foregrounded in detail.

Team proactiveness: teams largely react to prompts and external pressures, consistent with "reactive," though occasional initiative (e.g., strawman plans) edges slightly toward more proactive behavior.

overall_validity.rationale: Core variables—short-horizon, defined-outcome program objectives; systemic interdependence across tightly coupled workstreams; program-level but not org-wide authority; tight resources; frequent contextual shifts; reactive but not self-steering teams; divergent stakeholder priorities; and high (though not catastrophic) failure penalties—are all instantiated clearly and drive the narrative decisions. Rendering instructions are largely satisfied: the scenario is detailed, event-centric, avoids meta-commentary, and maintains temporal and narrative continuity; any added elements (like public white papers) are natural extensions of the specified context rather than major confounds. Minor deviations—slightly higher-than-specified frequency of contextual/resource updates, limited explicit illustration of negative failure penalties, and modest introduction of external critiques—do not meaningfully contaminate the behavioral test, which focuses on coordination under tight, ethics-constrained, interdependent conditions.
